V. 32.
I am the GOD of Abraham—The Argument runs thus: GOD is not the GOD of the Dead, but of the Living: (For that Expreſſion, Thy GOD, implies both Benefit from GOD to Man, and Duty from Man to GOD) But He is the GOD of Abraham, Iſaac, and Jacob: Therefore Abraham, Iſaac, and Jacob are not dead, but living. Therefore, the Soul does not die with the Body. So indeed the Sadducees ſuppoſed, and it was on this Ground that they denied the Reſurrection.
